candidates.reason: Move hour extraction into a derived projection before grouping; retain EXTRACT and COUNT(*) types and NULL grouping.
candidates.sql: SELECT hour, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour FROM trips) AS projected GROUP BY hour

candidates.reason: Use a partitioned window count and DISTINCT to return one row per hour, including the NULL partition, while counting all duplicates.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips

candidates.reason: Move the calendar-day predicate into filtered aggregation and remove groups with no qualifying rows; preserve route NULLs and original count types.
candidates.sql: SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0

candidates.reason: Apply the original calendar-day filter, then use a partitioned window count and DISTINCT to preserve duplicate counts and NULL route groups without restricting anomalous dates.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
